set system host-name CE1.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

unit 0 family ethernet-switching interfa.explanation: Configure the interface with an ethnet exchange mode.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: interface-mode
parameters.explanation: Interface mode, access means access mode.

unit 0 family ethernet-switching port-mo.explanation: Configure the interface with the Tethernet exchange port mode as the trunk mode.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: port-mode
parameters.explanation: Port mode, trunk means trunk mode.

unit 10 vlan-id 10.explanation: Configure VLAN IDs for interface units.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: VLAN ID, used to identify different VLANs.

unit 10 family inet address 172.16.1.1/2.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses and subnet masks for interface units.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: IPv4 addresses assigned to interface units.
